propositions: Integration test harness lacks an out-of-window-but-alive key path to exercise clear_absent and its no-churn/change-gate contract at tier above unit

clear_absent in binding_lifecycle is unreachable in the current idempotency fixture because all keys are seeded in-window; the fixture and fake backend must be extended to model out-of-window and deleted keys

The mutation oracle for clear_absent's unconditional updated_at stamp (AC#2 from bug 02c4) requires spy-verified reach plus frozen clock to detect unwanted timestamp changes; byte comparison alone cannot catch this regression
A new integration test must verify out-of-window-alive keys reach clear_absent with zero mutations, zero Jira writes, unchanged updated_at, and stable bindings.json across repeated passes
A second integration test must pin the 404→alive round-trip: note_absent records absence with frozen lifecycle clock, and clear_absent's clearing branch resets the absence counter
